notes.statusZh: status 取值：active 已上线并接线，校验器按最严口径对撞；in-progress 元数据已定稿但运行时还没接上，校验器把「找不到声明」降级为 INFO；retired 不再加载。
notes.statusEn: status values: active — shipped and wired, validated at full strictness; in-progress — metadata is finalised but the runtime is not wired yet, so the validator downgrades cannot-verify lines to INFO; retired — not loaded.

modules.statusNoteZh: 元数据 v0.5.0：7 类结构 × 6 种任务（38 个允许格）全部上线，K1–G2 由 PT_GEN 生成器出题，另有 match / create 拖放小游戏；声音载体仅预留。
modules.statusNoteEn: Metadata v0.5.0: all 7 structures x 6 tasks (38 allowed cells) ship, K1-G2 generated by PT_GEN, plus drag match / create activities; the audio carrier is reserved only.

modules.statusNoteZh: 已实现全部 8 个元类型（数量、表示、数序与距离、部分与整体、组合拆分、估计、运算直觉、数量级），覆盖 K1-G2 四级。运行时为 learning/math/number-sense/generator.js 的「题型×年级」参数表现场生成，数字范围 K1≤5、K2≤10、G1≤20、G2≤100，年级差别首先来自题型结构和表示方式。单选之外已有点选交互：数轴定位、拿出 N 个、十格阵涂数、十和一搭数、点一刀分成两份（K1-G2 各年级按结构出现）。
modules.statusNoteEn: All 8 meta-types are implemented (quantity, representation, order and distance, part-whole, composition, estimation, operation sense, magnitude) across K1-G2. Questions are generated from a type x grade table in learning/math/number-sense/generator.js; ranges are K1<=5, K2<=10, G1<=20, G2<=100, and grades differ first by structure and representation. Beyond single choice there are tap interactions: place on a number line, take N, fill a ten-frame, build with tens and ones, cut into two parts (by grade and structure across K1-G2).

modules.statusNoteZh: 元数据 v0.2.0：七类模型（对应、分组、关系、空间、过程、数量、规则）全部有单选版，K1–G2 由 MD_GEN 生成器出题；match/build/simulate 交互版待做。
modules.statusNoteEn: Metadata v0.2.0: all seven model types (mapping, grouping, relationship, spatial, process, quantitative, rule) ship as single-choice, K1-G2 generated by MD_GEN; match/build/simulate interactions are not built.

modules.statusNoteZh: 元数据 v0.2.0：七类逻辑（分类、条件、排除、顺序、对应、推断、真伪）全部有单选版，K1–G2 由 LG_GEN 生成器出题，线索题共用约束求解器保证答案唯一；拖放与逻辑表交互版待做。
modules.statusNoteEn: Metadata v0.2.0: all seven logic types ship as single-choice, K1-G2 generated by LG_GEN, with a shared constraint solver guaranteeing unique answers; drag and logic-grid interactions are not built.

modules.statusNoteZh: K1–G2 均为生成式题库（learning/math/strategy/generator.js）：K1 路线比较（石头数、陷阱）、K2 规则排序/顺路拿东西/限步拿到、G1 金币预算/能量顺序/钥匙与门、G2 取饼干比赛/按钮变数/两种都要买/能量有上限；答案都由题面条件算出，不靠常识。内含小型状态/动作引擎（ST_ENGINE，BFS 最优解）。基因：RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING 为主，资源类加 RESOURCE.TRADEOFF，预测类加 PREDICT.CONSEQUENCE。拖拽/分配等新交互、5 档反馈量表、explain 说理题记录在 strategy.json 的 deferredRoadmap，留待后续。
modules.statusNoteEn: K1-G2 are generated (learning/math/strategy/generator.js): K1 route comparison (stones, traps), K2 rule ordering / pick-up route / within-the-steps, G1 coin budget / energy order / key and door, G2 cookie race / button machine / buy both kinds / energy with a cap. Every answer follows from the stated conditions, no common sense needed. Includes a small state/action engine (ST_ENGINE, BFS optimal solver). Genes: RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING plus RESOURCE.TRADEOFF for resource units and PREDICT.CONSEQUENCE for prediction units. Drag/allocate interactions, the 5-tier feedback scale and explain questions are recorded in strategy.json deferredRoadmap for later.

modules.statusNoteZh: K1–G2 已实现中文与 English 两个原生内容域及观察、理解、推理、结构、语言选择、表达、创造七个能力入口。内容池包含短文、故事、诗歌、童谣、寓言、对话、说明、程序、谜语与场景素材；已接通原文证据、卡片排序、hotspot、scene-select，以及分别独立的不计分 Express / Create Create→Compare→Reflect。产品体验同时保留定向 RootGene 的 Ability Training，并通过数据驱动的 Works/Journey registry 开放中文与 English、G1 与 G2 的四个代表作品，覆盖诗歌、童谣和寓言；其他素材仍需人工审阅后再登记。机械内容合同由 learning/language/test.html 审计，语义质量继续人工审稿。架构见 docs/language/LANGUAGE-MODULE-ARCHITECTURE.md。
modules.statusNoteEn: K1-G2 now implements two natively authored content domains, Chinese and English, with seven ability entries: observe, comprehend, infer, structure, language choice, express, and create. The pool includes passages, stories, poems, rhymes, fables, dialogues, informational and procedural texts, riddles, and scenes. Evidence selection, card ordering, hotspot, scene-select, and separate unscored Express / Create Create-Compare-Reflect sequences are wired. The product retains RootGene-focused Ability Training and uses a data-driven Works/Journey registry to expose four representative works across Chinese and English, G1 and G2, and poetry, rhyme, and fable genres. Other materials remain gated for human review before registration. Mechanical content contracts are audited by learning/language/test.html, while semantic quality remains under human review. See docs/language/LANGUAGE-MODULE-ARCHITECTURE.md.
